data.title: 提弗洛斯 · 雪夜露天暖泉解乏雾气
data.action: 靠在温泉池石沿湿润浴巾微松羞涩望来
data.lighting: 石灯笼暖光穿透缭绕白雾与微弱雪夜月色
data.description: 飘雪落在滚烫的露天汤池上方很快化作白雾。提弗洛斯只裹一条浸湿的米白华夫格浴巾倚在温润石壁旁，双颊被水汽熏出浅红，浴巾边沿随呼吸微微下滑，露出圆润肩线与深邃锁骨。她尾尖轻拨池水，低声唤你坐近些。
data.promptProse: Leaning against the warm stones of a steaming outdoor hot spring at night while snowflakes melt in the mist, Typhoeus holds her damp cream bath wrap loosely across her chest with flushed cheeks and an inviting gaze.
data.animaCaption: She leans back against the wet hot spring rocks in swirling steam, her damp bath wrap slipping slightly as she looks warmly at the viewer.
